verdict.rationale: Discord documents non-interactive automation paths: a REST API authenticated with bot tokens, Gateway WebSocket connections for event-driven apps, and webhooks explicitly suited to "CI/CD pipelines posting build results or deployment notifications." This lets Discord be driven headlessly from CI, but only by posting into it or building against its API. There is no first-party CLI or headless client mode in the evidence. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, CI-specific documentation or examples beyond webhook notifications, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
